title: The Prover's Bargain
description: ZKLoRA proof times across six base models: the prover bears 31–74 s of computation per LoRA module while the verifier spends 1–2 s. Toggle per-module vs full adapter set; tap a model to see total prover and verifier work — the asymmetry is the deal.
